CMWSSB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 108 Graduate and Technician Diploma Apprentice Posts - Complete Details

CMWSSB Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (CMWSSB) has announced a total of 108 vacancies for Graduate and Technician Diploma Apprentice posts. Eligible candidates can apply online till 17 October 2026.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 17 September 2026
  • Last Date : 17 October 2026
  • Online Application Start Date : 17 September 2026
  • Last Date to Enroll and Apply Through NATS : 17 October 2026
  • Shortlisted Candidates List : Fourth week of October 2026

Application Fee

  • Post Name : Graduate Apprentice and Technician Diploma Apprentice
  • Monthly Stipend : Rs.10,900 to Rs.12,300
  • Application Start Date : 17 September 2026
  • Last Date : 17 October 2026
  • NATS Establishment User ID : STNCHS000035
  • Online Application Start Date : 17 September 2026
  • Last Date to Enroll and Apply Through NATS : 17 October 2026
  • Shortlisted Candidates List : Fourth week of October 2026

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
